title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
TOTAL3 (alts ex-BTC/ETH) -10.9% (24h) → $800B — broad altcoin selloff, heaviest since early Sept.
TOTAL2 (ex-BTC) -8.3% (24h) → $1.10T; TOTAL market cap -4.6% → $2.65T.
BTC.D +3.0% (24h) → 58.48% — dominance rising as capital rotates out of alts.
Oil (WTI) +5.1% (24h) → $91.48 — Iran/Houthi supply shock; Brent holds above $100.
Fed: Warsh hawkish post-Jackson Hole; cumulative 2026 hike odds 70.5%; CPI Aug due Sep 11 08:30 ET.
